title: 门店净销售、利润与目标达成
context: 区域经理需要2025年门店经营表。
requirements: 每门店一行；有效线下订单，按原订单日期归属截至年底退货；毛利=净销售-退货冲减后成本；毛利率和目标达成率使用百分比，分母为0返回NULL；金额单位分。保留无销售门店。
commonError: 直接连接月目标与订单明细会重复累计目标。
executionSteps: 先按门店聚合销售与成本
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
